result.stdout:
FLEXON CLI 3.0.0
Usage: flexon-cli <command> [options]

Commands:
  serialize   Package one or more files into FLEXON v2
  deserialize Safely extract a FLEXON package
  encode      Convert one JSON value to FLEXON v2
  decode      Convert one FLEXON value to JSON
  inspect     Print FLEXON contents as JSON
  validate    Validate FLEXON contents against a JSON schema subset
  encrypt     Rewrap a FLEXON file with authenticated encryption
  decrypt     Remove authenticated encryption from a FLEXON file
  keygen      Generate an ECDSA P-256 signing key pair
  sign        Create a detached signature for a file
  verify-signature Verify a detached file signature
  benchmark   Measure a local round trip

Common options:
  -i, --input <path>           Input path (repeatable for serialize)
  -o, --output <path>          Output file or directory
  -c, --compression <method>   none, gzip, deflate, brotli
  --encryption <algorithm>     none, AES256, ChaCha20
  --password-env <name>        Read password from an environment variable
  --password-file <path>       Read password from a protected local file
  -e, --encrypt <password> [algorithm] (compatibility; less secure)
